mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (userId, businessId, orderDate, orderTotal, daId, orderState) VALUES (#{userId}, #{businessId}, #{orderDate}, #{orderTotal}, #{daId}, #{orderState})
mapper.sql: o.orderId, o.userId, o.businessId, o.orderDate, o.orderTotal, o.daId, o.orderState, o.tradeNo, b.businessId as b_businessId, b.businessName as b_businessName, b.businessImg as b_businessImg, b.businessAddress as b_businessAddress, b.businessExplain as b_businessExplain, b.orderTypeId as b_orderTypeId, b.starPrice as b_starPrice, b.deliveryPrice as b_deliveryPrice, b.remarks as b_remarks, od.odId as od_odId, od.orderId as od_orderId, od.foodId as od_foodId, od.quantity as od_quantity, f.foodId as f_foodId, f.foodName as f_foodName, f.foodExplain as f_foodExplain, f.foodImg as f_foodImg, f.foodPrice as f_foodPrice, f.businessId as f_businessId, f.remarks as f_remarks
mapper.select: select from orders o left join business b on b.businessId = o.businessId left join orderDetailet od on od.orderId = o.orderId left join food f on f.foodId = od.foodId where o.orderId = #{orderId}
mapper.update: update orders set orderState=#{orderState} where orderId=#{orderId}
update orders set tradeNo=#{tradeNo} where orderId=#{orderId}
